lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg6Cr2 (reduced formula Mg3Cr) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Cr and Mg each have 12 geometric neighbors, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 2.91–3.23 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component containing all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces.
